name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-powered presentation builder that produces polished decks without the generic, over-designed output typical of AI tools.
problem: Creating professional presentations is time-consuming, and most AI slide tools produce bland, templated results that require heavy editing. Chronicle 2.0 addresses the gap between AI speed and human-quality design, letting teams build compelling decks faster without sacrificing visual integrity.
useCases: Building investor pitch decks with a distinctive visual style
Creating client-facing sales presentations at scale
Producing internal strategy or roadmap decks quickly
Turning written reports or documents into structured slide narratives
